about.title: About the project
about.intro: Beyond The Arc is a portfolio project by Gurvan Le Pape: French basketball, from regional to departmental level, as a site you can browse.

data.title: The data
data.real: The competition structure is real: {leagues, number} leagues, {committees, number} departmental committees and {clubs, number} clubs in metropolitan France, scraped from the FFBB's public site and placed on the map from their addresses with the French government's address API (BAN).
data.simulated: Everything inside it is simulated: {championships, number} championships, {teams, number} teams and {players, number} players with generated names. A scheduler plays each match at its scheduled time, event by event, and that gives every result, box score and shot chart on the site.

stack.title: How it's built
stack.body: A Next.js frontend, rendered on the server, reads a public, read-only REST API written with NestJS and Prisma over PostgreSQL. The scheduler is a Python service. It all runs in Docker Compose on a single server, deployed by GitLab CI on every merge, with errors reported to Sentry and logs and metrics in Grafana.
stack.more: The <link>architecture page</link> has the diagram and the full stack.

contract.title: One contract
contract.description: The API's OpenAPI schema is committed, the frontend's types are generated from it, and CI fails if either is out of date.

readOnly.title: Public and read-only
readOnly.description: No accounts and no writes: every endpoint is a GET, every query parameter is validated, and paginated lists stop at 100 rows.

oneServer.title: One server
oneServer.description: Everything runs on a single VPS, with no replica and no staging: a merge to main that passes CI goes straight to production.

product.title: Product
product.subtitle: What you can look up on the site, for every championship from regional to departmental level.

leaderboards.title: Standings
leaderboards.description: A standings table for every pool, updated as each result comes in.

matchSummary.title: Match pages
matchSummary.description: The two teams' stats side by side, each player's box score, shot charts and the event timeline, filtered by quarter.

shotCharts.title: Shot charts
shotCharts.description: Every shot a player took, made or missed, where it was taken; and a team's shooting zone by zone, with its percentage.

playerComparison.title: Player comparison
playerComparison.description: Two players' per-game averages side by side: points, rebounds, assists, steals, blocks, turnovers and fouls.

clubsMap.title: Clubs map
clubsMap.description: Every club in metropolitan France, placed from its address. Zoom in from regions to departments to the clubs themselves.

teamRosters.title: Rosters
teamRosters.description: Each team's players, with their position and per-game averages.

matchSchedule.title: Fixtures and results
matchSchedule.description: Every pool's matches, played and upcoming, round by round.

i18n.title: French and English
i18n.description: Every page in both languages, switched from the header.

themes.title: Light, dark and high contrast
themes.description: Three themes, chosen from the header.

responsive.title: Phone to desktop
responsive.description: Every page laid out for a 360px phone up to a wide screen.

organizations.title: Leagues, committees and clubs
organizations.description: Every regional league with its committees, every departmental committee with its clubs, and every club with its teams.

search.title: Search
search.description: Find a player, team or match, and narrow the results by category, gender, level and location.

structure.featurePrinciple: Each feature (e.g. 'clubs') contains its own components, hooks, api, utils, constants, types, and index.ts for modularity.
structure.sharedExplanation: Reusable code (components, hooks, utils, types) lives in shared/.
structure.libExplanation: External libraries, API clients, and providers are in lib/.
structure.stylesExplanation: Global styles and themes are in styles/.
structure.publicExplanation: Static files are served from public/.
